tool.title: Site search index
tool.description: The just-the-docs search index, `assets/js/search-data.json`, which the theme writes as part of the Jekyll site build: one entry per page section, searched by every page's search box. Built implicitly by the build rather than by a command of its own.

inputs: the pages of the Jekyll site build (`cat-harness/docs/`)

$comment.comment: input-site: inert #4279ca6f — prose naming the directory, in a message or a description
